image_description: A low-angle shot of a large, white rectangular street sign mounted on a yellow cylindrical post. The sign features black text that appears to be gibberish or heavily distorted ('US WA...'). There is a surreal, AI-generated artifact in the center: a small figure of a person in a dark suit with red accents, seemingly fused into or climbing out of the sign's surface. Above the main sign, there are disjointed black structural elements and another smaller yellow object against a grey sky.
